Profiles host and downloads payload from Tor network

Starts v3 Onion Service with unique address
Checks running processes for analysis tools
Starts XMRig Monero miner using all CPU threads when user inactive
Monitors clipboard for copied cryptocurrency addresses and replaces them with attacker addresses
Attack Vector: Distributed via game and pirated software cracks
Spread on P2P networks, torrent indexers, YouTube videos
Indicators of Compromise: 4375 cryptocurrency wallet addresses believed to have received stolen funds

Scheduled tasks and registry keys for persistence
Clipboard hijacking of cryptocurrency wallet addresses
